note: views_flipped_table provides one Views style plugin, flipped_table ('Flipped Table'), extending core's Table style. It transposes the table (results become columns, fields become rows) and adds one extra option, flipped_table_header_first_field (bool, default TRUE). Theme hook views_view_flipped_table / template views-view-flipped-table.html.twig; preprocessor ViewsFlippedTableThemeHooks. In a view config it is display.<id>.display_options.style.type = flipped_table with options under style.options (all core Table options inherited; row_class options hidden). No settings form (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no own config schema. Introspection/execution cases build real views (vft_*) and read/verify the live view config's style type and the header option.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal views_flipped_table module, what is the machine name (id) of the Views style plugin it adds, and which core Views style does it extend?
evals.expected_output: It adds the Views style plugin id 'flipped_table' (title 'Flipped Table'), which extends the core Table style (Drupal\views\Plugin\views\style\Table) and transposes rows/columns.

evals.prompt: The Flipped Table style from views_flipped_table adds one extra style option on top of the core table settings. What is that option's machine name and what does it do?
evals.expected_output: It adds flipped_table_header_first_field (default TRUE, 'Show the first field as the table header') - when on, the first field's flipped row is rendered inside <th> header cells.

evals.prompt: Which theme hook / Twig template does the views_flipped_table Flipped Table style render with, and how do I override its markup?
evals.expected_output: Theme hook views_view_flipped_table, template views-view-flipped-table.html.twig (preprocessed by ViewsFlippedTableThemeHooks). Override the twig template in your theme to change the markup; no CSS is shipped.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a view with machine name 'vft_demo'. Inspect the live view and tell me which Views display style (format) its default display uses.
evals.expected_output: vft_demo's default display uses the flipped_table style: display.default.display_options.style.type = flipped_table.

evals.prompt: The view 'vft_probe' on this site uses the Flipped Table style. Inspect its live configuration and tell me whether its 'Show the first field as the table header' option (flipped_table_header_first_field) is enabled or disabled.
evals.expected_output: vft_probe uses the flipped_table style and its flipped_table_header_first_field option is set to false (disabled) in style.options.

evals.prompt: On this site the view 'vft_task' currently uses the standard Table format. Change its default display to use the views_flipped_table 'Flipped Table' style instead, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set display.default.display_options.style.type to 'flipped_table' on view vft_task and save. Because flipped_table extends the core Table style, the existing table options remain valid.

evals.prompt: The view 'vft_task2' on this site is a Flipped Table, and right now it is showing the first field as a bold header row. Turn that off so the first field is shown like the other rows, and save the change.
evals.expected_output: Set style.options.flipped_table_header_first_field to false on vft_task2's flipped_table display and save, so the first field renders as normal <td> cells rather than <th> headers.
